rationale: S-0034-02 proposes an AR(2) rho sweep at the t0024 baseline morphology. Like S-0026-02, this is a t0024-substrate noise-correlation experiment. The from-scratch wave currently uses deterministic NetStim trials (no noise); a future task to add AR(2) noise to the from-scratch substrate would supersede this. Reprioritising from high to medium pending that future noise-injection task.
